# M1 tables (generated by examples/vexp_analyze.py)

official = `baseline` (the official code); varying = `results/vexp/` (data/LOM_vexp); LOM = `results/rung0/`. Effects are paired by seed; (x×) = mean effect / noise, with noise = sqrt(mean of the seed variances of the two arms); * = |effect| > 2× noise. Raw PSNR, SSIM and LPIPS are taken from the re-score (identical to the training-time eval, see the integrity checks).
